title: Trip plan
audience: For anyone planning a trip who wants the plan, bookings and packing in one place.
description: A countdown, the days, bookings and a packing list. Edit it yourself, or let your AI fill it in.
tagline: Days, bookings and a packing list.
seoTitle: Trip planner and itinerary template for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Trip plan

Everything for one trip: the plan for each day, the bookings, and what to pack. All of it lives in the app. This note is for anything else you want to keep with the trip.

## Ideas
Places and things to remember that aren't in the plan yet.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Trip plan". It is an app; its data is "Trip plan.app/data.json", beside the note. Read it with fetch before each change, and change it with edit. I'll tell you where I'm going, when, and what I like. Set values.trip (name, place, start, end as yyyy-mm-dd) and write values.days: one { date, title, items } per day with three to five realistic items, with travel time between places. Start items with a time ("09:30 Tram 28"). When I paste a booking confirmation, add { id, what, kind, date, time, ref, paid } to values.bookings (kind: flight, train, stay, food, activity, other). Add what the trip needs to values.packing as { id, text, group, packed: false }.

asks: Ask where and when I'm going and what I enjoy, then plan the trip.
What do I still need to book?

args.old_string: Places and things to remember that aren't in the plan yet.
args.new_string:
Places and things to remember that aren't in the plan yet.
- A fado night in Alfama
- Bring back tinned sardines for Jonas
- Ask Maja for her list of bakeries
